claim: An entity can have any number of inline policies, but their total size per entity cannot exceed 2,048 characters for a user, 10,240 characters for a role and 5,120 characters for a group; white space is not counted.
question: What is the aggregate inline policy size limit for a user, a role and a group?

values.spoken: two thousand forty-eight characters for a user
ten thousand two hundred forty characters for a role
five thousand one hundred twenty characters for a group

qualifiers.scope: per IAM user, role or group (sum of all inline policies)
